name: pastea-mcp
description: Search, read and re-copy your Mac clipboard history from Claude — Pastea's local, private MCP bridge.
long_description:
Pastea is a clipboard history manager for macOS. This extension lets Claude search what you have copied, read a clip in full (including text recognized inside screenshots), list your lists, and put a clip back on the clipboard for you to paste. It never deletes anything, never pastes into other apps, and never shows items Pastea conceals (from password managers).

Requires Pastea 1.3 or later with Pastea Pro on this Mac, and Enable MCP turned on in Pastea → Settings → MCP & AI Tools. The first time Claude uses it, Pastea asks you to allow the connection; you can revoke it there at any time.

Everything runs on your Mac. The extension talks only to Pastea on 127.0.0.1 and sends nothing anywhere else.

tools.name: search_clips
tools.description: Search the user's Pastea clipboard history and collections. Returns recent clips when no query is given. Matches text content, URLs, titles, file names, and text recognized inside screenshots.

tools.name: get_clip
tools.description: Read one clip in full: the complete text as copied (or the text recognized inside an image), link, color, and file details, plus a thumbnail for image clips.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the user's Pastea collections: the clipboard history plus any lists they made, with clip counts.

tools.name: copy_clip
tools.description: Put a clip back on the system clipboard, exactly as it was copied (all formats preserved). The user can then paste it themselves with Cmd-V. Does not paste into any app.

tools.name: pastea_status
tools.description: Reports whether Pastea is reachable and connected on this Mac, and what to do if it is not.
